    score: 9.5
    verdict: pass
    note: "Independent scan found five material conflicts; all five carry conflicting rows and explicit PDD callouts: CBFs per community (brief 'two' vs Enock 'one in Malawi', sec 6 callout); savings gating (form asks at every meeting vs savings introduced Step 5, 5.5); household-count source (5.3/C2); FCAP step taxonomy (24 declared vs duplicated Step 19, C1); currency MWK vs program USD (14 locale warning, 15.3). Payment-unit vs grain reconciliation: payment_rate_unit 'verified community meeting' is not finer than entity_id_grain (one key per meeting for meetings 1-3; the only intended collapse is 4th+) - no unflagged grain conflict. Payment rows correctly tagged inferred/external. Minor non-material: research brief '~6 months weekly' vs Structure 'Planning 5.5 months' - PDD uses the partner document."
  - ref: demand_reality
    score: 8.0
    verdict: pass
    note: "Named consumer with scoped commitment: Spark's M&E Director confirmed the anchor form, the field-level predicate, the CBF as payee and the pilot slice; S1-S4 reuse Spark's own indicator definitions and stored codes so outputs join to Spark's data. No pre-committed action by date (Spark has not agreed to run or fund the pilot; FOCCAD not asked; who funds CBF payments unstated) -> 8.0 not 9.5."
  - ref: resource_realism
    score: 7.0
    verdict: pass
    note: "Prior WARN (no band) addressed: MWK 5,000-10,000/meeting [PROPOSED] with an hours table. Grader cross-check: against a Malawi statutory minimum of roughly MWK 90,000/month (~MWK 430/h; grader's recollection, not in the source pack), the CBF side clears the floor even at the low end with committee meetings (MWK 667/h, ~50% buffer). But the org fee does not cover the verification work the PDD assigns: 156 x MWK 1,500 = MWK 234,000 (~USD 135 at official rates) for 16 weeks of supervision, >=20% risk-stratified Layer B with in-person observation of at least half of S-1, >=10% Layer C calls, and photo review across 12 rural communities - so the LLO or Spark must subsidise it. Device/airtime cost uncosted (flagged as go/no-go). Net: clears the floor on the FLW side, under-costed on overhead."
  - ref: mission_alignment
    score: 7.0
    verdict: pass
    note: "PDD labels primaries as an upstream proxy and documents the chain. P2 (payment integrity) and P4 (review agreement) directly measure the pilot's stated goal ('whether a meeting recorded as held was held'); P1 (regularity) and P3 (progression) are process/programme proxies. Mixed direct + documented proxy -> 7.0."
  - ref: fallback_validates_primary
    score: 7.5
    verdict: pass
    note: "Prior WARN (uniform sampling, 6.0) substantively fixed: stratified S-1 flagged / S-2 random verified / S-3 10% not-paid (the negative class), agreement reported per stratum. Held below 9.0 because the independent ground truth is partly incoherent: Spark's Facilitator Quality Monitoring / FMF-RCT forms are filled by a Partner Trainer who ATTENDS a meeting, so a record sampled after submission cannot be 'observed in person'; desk review of photo+record re-examines the primary's own evidence. Only Layer C calls (consenting communities only) give post-hoc independent truth. No false-negative metric is defined for S-3."
  - ref: must_not_assert_mechanisms
    score: 10
    verdict: pass
    note: "Checked GPS gates, Connect photo/attachment checks, per-attempt item rotation, bare now() floors, conditional case create: none asserted as enforced; all stated as buildable approximations with residual named."
  - ref: ccz_claims
    score: 9.5
    verdict: pass
    note: "Verified in XML: forms-4.xml binds at 146 (meeting_conducted) and 150 (meeting_type), stored codes yes/no and community_meeting/committee_meeting; photo bind type=binary required (149, inside the held branch); currently_saving required with no relevance (221), detail fields relevant on currently_saving='1' (222-228); not-held codes match; 0 geopoints in forms-4 and exactly 5 other forms with geopoints; forms-0 hh_tt calculate=0 feeding hh_count_tt, number_of_households <=400 and average_household_size 4-12 not written to case; forms-1 increments hh_count_tt; phase written by m0f0/f3/f5/f8 only; 0 files with commcareconnect; cur_locale=en; foccad_activities lookup present. Minor: CF Registration education options are None/Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/University (PDD lists 'other', disclosed 'to be reconciled'); Spark's duplicate message is 'This is a duplicate CF. It already exists', paraphrased in 5.1."

  - severity: WARN
    message: "numbers_consistent / payment cap off-by-one: sec 14 entity_id_grain `concat(case_id, '-', pilot_fcap_step, '-', min(step_meeting_index, 3))` with sec 5.2 'the community record starts at ... step_meeting_index = 0' and sec 7.1.3 'Layer A reads the community's pilot_fcap_step and step_meeting_index'. Read from the case (pre-increment) the keys are 0,1,2,3 -> 4 payable meetings per step and 28 per CBF, contradicting '3 per step', total_cap_per_flw 21 and the budget. Fix: say explicitly that the key uses the post-increment index (1-based), or use min(step_meeting_index + 1, 3) on the case value."
  - severity: WARN
    message: "archetype_coherence / payability against history: sec 7.1.3 claims the key 'is what makes the 3-per-step cap real and what stops the same meeting being paid twice'. It does not: the key carries no meeting date, and every held submission increments step_meeting_index, so a duplicate submission of one meeting gets a new key and is paid (daily cap 2 allows it on the same day). Fix: add a constraint date_of_meeting > the case's last date_of_meeting (screen 2 currently only requires 'not before the community's enrolment date'), or put date_of_meeting in the key, or restate the claim as 'caught by S-1 review' rather than prevented."

    message: "fallback_validates_primary / Layer B ground truth: sec 7.2 S-1 'All reviewed (photo + record), and at least half observed in person or confirmed by Layer C' - the Facilitator Quality Monitoring Form and FMF-RCT are completed by a Partner Trainer who attends a meeting, so a record flagged after submission cannot be observed in person. Fix: say that S-1 flags trigger an unannounced observation of that CBF's NEXT meeting and a Layer C call for the flagged record itself, and make Layer C the independent check for post-hoc samples."
  - severity: WARN
    message: "feasibility_headline_metrics / P4: sec 8.1 P4 denominator 'reviewed paid meetings' includes desk-only reviews that have neither a 'Layer B observation or Layer C confirmation', so agreement is undefined for them. Also S-1 membership 'a photo that looks like another meeting's' (7.2) has no detection procedure. Fix: set P4's denominator to 'reviewed paid meetings with an observation or a confirmation call', and either define the photo-duplicate check (for example, a supervisor comparing each photo with the same community's previous one) or drop it from the stratum's entry rule."
  - severity: WARN
    message: "resource_realism / org fee vs assigned verification work: sec 10.1 'MWK 1,500 per verified meeting to the implementing organisation for supervision, Layer B visits and Layer C calls' totals ~MWK 234,000 (156 x 1,500, about USD 135) for 16 weeks of >=20% risk-stratified review, in-person observations and >=10% calls across 12 communities. That does not cover travel for observation visits, so Spark or the LLO would subsidise it without saying so. Fix: cost the Layer B/C workload (visits x transport + staff-days), or state that Spark's already-funded Partner Trainer monitoring visits carry Layer B and the fee covers only calls and desk review."
  - severity: WARN
    message: "numbers_consistent / Layer B base: sec 7.2 'reviews at least 20% of all meeting records' but S-2 is 'A random draw from the remaining paid meetings ... Enough to bring the total to >= 20%', and sec 14 layer_b_review_sample does not name a base. Choose one base (all records or paid meetings) and use it in 7.2, 12 and 14."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "clean-source branch active: graded on deferred-decision discipline (no reviewer comments in the source pack; drive_list_comments returned zero threads per sec 16)."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "Prior-eval WARNs re-checked against the text: Layer B uniform sampling -> FIXED (stratified with a negative-class stratum, but see the ground-truth WARN); no rate band -> FIXED (band plus hours arithmetic, all recomputed correctly); out-of-order payability silence -> FIXED (sec 3.2 'cannot happen by construction'); P1 'scheduled meetings' denominator -> FIXED (community-weeks from captured dates)."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "No must-not-assert mechanism is asserted as enforced. GPS (5.6), Connect photo/GPS checks (7.1) and item rotation (4.2, correctly Table B / capability request) are all stated honestly."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "Self-eval (5 pass + 1 partial, ~9.2/10 equivalent) vs this eval 7.75: gap >= 1.5. The idea-to-pdd self-rubric passed Executability and Verifiability without catching the entity_id off-by-one or the duplicate-submission gap. Inflation cap does not bind (self-eval not 5/5)."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "sec 15.2 carried-forward rows have no owner column, and several have no resolution mechanism (phase-authoritative-writer, connect-markers-in-sparks-own-app, proposal-generator-boundary)."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "Minor CCZ fidelity: sec 5.1 cbf_education lists 'other' where Spark has 'University' (disclosed as 'to be reconciled'). The duplicate-CBF message is paraphrased: Spark's text is 'This is a duplicate CF. It already exists'. The written-back property is `Total_participation`, but Spark's case property is `Total_Participation`."
  - severity: INFO
    message: "P3 target (>=75% complete Step 7 within 13 weeks) sits at the expected duration itself (~13 weekly meetings), with no slack for the Christmas period inside the window. Consider whether 13 weeks should be the target or the expectation."

revision_note: >-
  THIRD grade. This verdict grades the SECOND revision of the Work Order. The earlier grades
  were 6.9/fail on the original draft and 7.65/fail on the first revision. All seven
  dimensions were re-graded from scratch against the current wo.txt, idea-to-pdd.md and
  decisions.yaml.
  RESOLVED since the second grade:
  (a) Device funding. Section 2 now reads "the partner will cost device provision separately
  in its solicitation response; devices are funded under this Work Order only if Dimagi
  agrees that cost at contract execution, in addition to the not-to-exceed". This matches
  PDD section 12 item 1.
  (b) The daily-limit contradiction. 6.2 now reads "No more than 1 verified meeting per CBF
  per day". The "two paid meetings in one day" flag is removed from 4.2. PDD 7.1(6), 10.1 and
  section 14 daily_cap_per_flw = 1, and decisions per-flw-caps-revised supersedes
  per-flw-caps.
  (c) The flagged-record check that could not be performed. It now reads "a confirmation call
  where the community contact has agreed to calls, or otherwise Partner Trainer attendance at
  that CBF's next meeting". That is consistent with the consent rule in 8.1 and with PDD 7.2
  S-1.
  (d) The actorless passive. It now reads "the partner will also check a random 10 percent of
  unpaid records".
  All prior WARNs from the first grade stay resolved: the advance refund, the currency basis,
  the deduction target, Annexure B, the 10% unpaid sample, FLW replaced by CBF, the 24-hour
  notices, and "Dimagi will deduct".
  STILL OPEN: none. Residuals are noted per item and are not strikes.

per_item:
  - ref: verification_realism
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      Every 4.2 criterion is backed by a real mechanism. meeting_conducted = yes and
      meeting_type = community_meeting are Connect form_field_rules. The first-to-third
      meeting per step cap works through entity_id dedup (concat(case_id, step,
      min(index,3))), the dedup Connect actually has (ace#1013). The 1/day and 21-total limits
      are payment-unit daily and total caps. The date-later-than-previous rule, photo,
      attendance, participation <= attendance and savings from step 5 are in-form constraints
      and required fields. No GPS, photo or duplicate check is claimed of Connect: "they do not
      gate payment and no submission is refused on the basis of a location reading". The
      revised Layer B uses only feasible checks (a consented call, or attendance at the next
      meeting). Residual: case ownership and the date rule are client-side form constraints
      with no server-side re-check.
  - ref: commercial_realism
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      No strikes. Assumptions: about MWK 1,750 per USD at the official rate, and Malawi's
      statutory minimum wage at about MWK 126,000 a month (about MWK 4,800 a day). On that
      basis the CBF band of MWK 5,000-10,000 per meeting (about USD 3-6 for about 5.5 h) is a
      plausible facilitator stipend. The partner fee of MWK 3,000 per meeting is still thin at
      face value (about USD 270-430 over the pilot). But it is labelled a planning figure, and
      the partner must "cost its supervision and review work explicitly", with the costed
      response attached as Annexure B, so the market price is set at execution. The device
      strike is RESOLVED: devices are costed separately and funded "in addition to the
      not-to-exceed" only if agreed. The advance is recoverable, with a 30-day refund of any
      undrawn balance. The deduction for a paid meeting later disproved is explicit.
      Termination, liability, IP and data-ownership clauses are absent by design (MSA annex),
      and the NTE is the sanctioned bracketed form; neither is struck.
  - ref: contractual_clarity
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      The unit, verified-unit criteria, exclusions, RACI, acceptance window ("within 15 days
      ... deemed accepted"), currency basis, advance mechanics, deduction target and annexures
      are all defined. The daily cap (1) is now consistent with the date rule. The flagged-
      record check now respects call consent. Residual (not a strike): 6.1 still calls the
      NTE "Dimagi's total financial commitment" while section 2 funds agreed device costs "in
      addition to the not-to-exceed". The carve-out is explicit, but a one-line cross-reference
      in 6.1 would remove the only seam a careful signer might query.
  - ref: pdd_alignment
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      The draft matches the revised PDD on every point checked: scope (steps 1-7, about 12
      communities, one CBF each), geography (one Malawi district, not named), the predicate,
      the 3-per-step cap, the daily cap of 1 (PDD 7.1(6), 10.1, section 14), the date rule
      (5.4 screen 2), Layer B (20% of paid + 10% unpaid, with a call where consented and
      otherwise attendance at the next meeting; 7.2 S-1), 10% Layer C calls, devices costed
      separately (section 12 item 1), the rates MWK 5,000-10,000 + 3,000, the NTE 3,276,000,
      and the opportunity window 2026-11-02 to 2027-02-26.
  - ref: decisions_traceability
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      "No more than 1 verified meeting per CBF per day" matches per-flw-caps-revised, which
      supersedes per-flw-caps. The 3,276,000 ceiling matches wo-total-not-to-exceed-revised.
      MWK 3,000 matches llo-payment-per-visit-revised. The period 2026-10-26 to 2027-03-12
      matches wo-period-of-performance. 40/60 matches wo-payment-schedule-split. Weekly
      reporting matches wo-reporting-cadence. About 12 CBFs matches flw-count. United States
      matches wo-data-storage-region. Every superseded row carries a superseded_by pointer.
  - ref: archetype_fit
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      The draft fits the longitudinal-visits archetype. The community is the followed entity
      across an ordered FCAP step sequence ("each qualifying visit in that sequence is
      separately payable"), and payability reads the community's history (step, per-step
      index, previous meeting date). The draft includes step-overrun buffers and a
      step-correction role. There is no per-session or multi-stage leakage.
  - ref: writing_style
    grade: pass
    note: >-
      No strikes. Every acronym is expanded on first use: FCAP, CBF, M&E, MWK, MSA. "FLW"
      no longer appears. There is no "shall", no hyperbole, no "CommCare Connect" or "the
      platform", and no vague commitments; both notices are "within 24 hours". The previously
      struck passive is now "the partner will also check a random 10 percent of unpaid
      records". Remaining passives name or imply their actor ("devices are funded ... only if
      Dimagi agrees", "converted to USD at the exchange rate the parties agree") and are not
      struck. The partner-naming definition lands correctly, and "Subcontractor" appears only
      as the signature-block label. Bold was noted but not graded, per the stale rubric note.
